parent_objective: design compact replay/objective corpus conversion for the refreshed post-short-promotion surface
blocked_by: M1056 confirms M1055 surface is robust under 0.005m diagnostic bucket width and should be converted before medium PPO
invalidates: using the refreshed surface in PPO before compact corpus conversion and replay sanity

public_gates: M1057 must not train or run PPO
M1057 must specify compact corpus selection from M1055 accepted rows
M1057 must specify objective sanity and replay sanity before any further PPO

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs conversion of M1055 refreshed rows into replay/objective corpora after M1056 bucket audit
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no conversion run, no training, no PPO, no promotion
stop_condition: stop if corpus caps would make the surface duplicate-dominated
stop if objective sanity and replay sanity are not both specified
stop if conversion would route directly to PPO
fallback_plan: if design is clear, route to compact corpus conversion implementation
if caps make the corpus too small, route to retargeted surface mining
if replay sanity cannot be defined, route to proof-surface audit
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1056 classifies M1055 as coarse bucket artifact and admits conversion design

hypothesis: The M1055 accepted rows can be converted into compact source-capped objective/replay corpora for the short-PPO current family before any further PPO.
failure_criteria: objective or replay sanity is missing
decision_rule: M1057 must design compact corpus conversion and cannot train, run PPO, promote, or use private holdout.
